correctness.rationale: Total domination makes all selected-neighbor signatures nonempty. Equal signatures of two unselected vertices then share a neighbor, so their cyclic column distance is at most two. For n>=5 the five consecutive columns are distinct and contain every neighbor needed for each forward comparison; iterating checks every possible collision, including at the wrap. Overlap of four-symbol states gives exactly the column words on a closed length-n walk and charges each column's population once. I independently implemented strip signatures as bitset intersections and computed exact sparse distances backwards from every terminal state. This gave 729 transitions and 41,728 finite entries in each of T^8 and T^18; all 65,536 state pairs satisfy identical finiteness and a weight shift eight on the finite ones. Multiplying by T^(n-8) transports this exact identity to every n>=8; it is not a conjectured pattern from trace samples. Independent direct subset enumeration gave minima 3,4,4,6,6,7 at n=3..8, and exact traces at n=5..18 agree with the claimed formula, completing the residue induction. The baseline cubic bound also follows by counting edges across S and its complement: at most 2|S| such edges and at least 2(2n-|S|)-|S|, since at most |S| outsiders can have distinct singleton signatures.
